slides.headline: His parents immigrated from India to Georgia. On November 3, 2026, he became the first Sikh ever elected to its state legislature.
Jyot Singh won Georgia House District 97, becoming the first Sikh American and first Indian American elected to the Georgia General Assembly.
slides.body: Raised in Norcross, Georgia, by Sikh and Punjabi immigrant parents from India, Singh defeated Republican Yassin Moghazy in the November 3, 2026 general election, after winning his Democratic primary in May 2026 with 59.1% of the vote.

slides.headline: A Yale global affairs graduate who founded his own consulting firm, Blue Husky Group.
slides.body: His campaign centered on affordability, healthcare, and housing, and included events at the Guru Nanak Mission Society in Norcross - the community he grew up in now sending him to represent it statewide.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: A Viksit Bharat benefits every time the diaspora it produced reaches further into the institutions that shape its adopted countries.
slides.body: Singh's win adds a Sikh American voice to a state legislature for the first time - one more place where an Indian immigrant family's story became part of the wider story of American representation.
